description: Replace torch.geqrf with a single-file CUTE DSL/tiled Householder QR path specialized for dominant batched n=512 cases, one CTA or cooperative CTA group per matrix panel, storing compact H and tau in FP32 while preserving hard mixed and ill-conditioned correctness.

Build a CUTE DSL blocked QR implementation for large n=1024-4096 with panel factorization plus trailing update tiles, prioritizing fewer torch/LAPACK launches and coalesced shared-memory staging while returning exact geqrf-style compact Householder factors.

Create a CUTE DSL hybrid dispatcher that detects small n=32/176/352 and upper-triangular or rank-deficient easy structures, using custom fast specialized kernels there and falling back only for unsupported hard cases after profiling baseline launch overhead.

Combine 49decc and 11c593: integrate the n=32 custom Householder QR fast path with the n=512/1024 rank-deficient short-factor/padded compact-output path, resolving dispatch/output-shape conflicts and preserving full validation; only clean up guarded CUDA/CUTLASS/CUTE scaffolding when it is executable in this environment, with no unavailable DSL-only code.

Extend 9d8710b4 by turning its structural special cases into device-side mixed-batch dispatch: cheaply classify each matrix as reduced-width rankdef/clustered-tail/near-rank or dense without host sync, route only eligible matrices through reduced QR, preserve compact FP32 geqrf output/layout, and benchmark mixed batches where dense matrices correctly fall back.

Extend 98af4b with a dense medium-size CUDA QR fast path for n=176 first, using one matrix per CTA or panel-tiled Householder to reduce torch.geqrf overhead; try n=352 only after n=176 validates, preserve existing n=32 and n=512 rankdef wins, and dispatch by shape only with no broad dense/upper detection launches.

Combine 2c0f05's n=176 custom CUDA QR path with eaf3c7's cleaned n=32 and n=512/1024 rank-deficient short-factor paths, preserving shape-only dispatch and excluding upper/CUTE probes. First validate and benchmark all stacked executable paths for regressions; only then profile n=352 as the next medium-size target.

Combine 2c0f05's n=176 custom CUDA QR fast path with only 782c282's mixed-batch dense/eligible split and reduced-width rankdef/clustered structural paths; keep n=176 and all-dense fallback on the preexisting cheap shape-only dispatch path with no added classifier/split overhead, then validate and benchmark stacked behavior before adding any new classifier logic.

Profile and micro-tune the existing n=176 one-CTA Householder QR path from 2c0f05 without changing dispatch: first reduce per-column global traffic or shared-reduction synchronization based on ncu/nsys evidence, then sweep only the smallest needed block/unroll/register knobs; preserve n=32 and n=512 rankdef paths and do not retry n=352 unless n=176 improves.

Combine from global-best 7d34d85 as base by surgically transplanting b272351's warp-shuffle block-reduction micro-tune for n=176 only; preserve all stacked dispatch wins for n=32 and n=512/1024 rankdef/clustered mixed-split paths, audit shape-only routing for regressions, validate correctness, and benchmark the pure combined stack before any further edits.

From global-best 7d34d85, pursue a fresh n=352 macro path unlike the failed one-CTA global-memory Householder: implement a blocked panel QR with tiled trailing-update kernels/shared-memory panels, preserving existing n=32/n=176/rankdef/mixed dispatch; profile the minimal executable path and abandon if n352 remains slower than torch.geqrf.

Reduce mixed-split overhead on d0eb40 by moving rankdef/clustered eligibility classification into a tiny CUDA mask+count/compact path, preferably one lightweight kernel with dense-fast all-zero/all-one fallback; preserve n32/n176 shape dispatch and validate mixed n512/n1024 gains without dense regressions.

Redesign only the n=176 path on d0eb40 to reduce global matrix traffic: stage Householder panel/column data in shared memory/registers and fuse read-modify-write updates across trailing columns where possible, preserving 256-thread warp reductions and all n32/rankdef/mixed dispatch behavior; profile current n176 first, then compare n176 speed/correctness before touching wider code.

On parent 6733ae57, specialize only the n1024 near-rank case: add a conservative cheap CUDA-side detector for trailing-column dependence, factor a safe leading subspace with contract-preserving padded output, and fall back unchanged for dense n1024 and all existing n32/n176/rankdef/clustered/mixed paths; reject any detector overhead that hurts dense n1024.

Combine f941199 as base with only 6733ae's inline CUDA classifier changes for n512/n1024 rankdef/clustered masks/counts; preserve n176 staged-vcol/barrier behavior, n32, and mixed-split dispatch, validate the pure stack first, and compare active buckets (n176, n512, n1024, n32, mixed) before any follow-on edits.

Explore a separate large-square dense QR fallback for n2048/n4096 using torch/cusolver workspace and output handling more directly than the current geqrf wrapper: profile allocation, copy, and factorization boundaries, then restructure only the large dense dispatch to avoid redundant materialization and postprocessing; preserve all existing small, n176, rank-deficient, mixed, and classifier-sensitive paths.

Reduce n512/n1024 structural classifier bandwidth on 268f2ec without extra launches or host syncs: restructure the inline CUDA scan to short-circuit or split rankdef vs clustered tail checks so obvious rankdef/clustered batches do less memory work while preserving mixed overlap semantics, rankdef precedence, n176/n32 dispatch, and dense fallback; benchmark active rankdef/clustered/mixed buckets plus full geomean, keep only real wins.

Further redesign n176 on 268f2ec: tile trailing-column Householder updates over small column blocks so each loaded/staged v/tau is reused across multiple columns with fewer global read/write passes; try warp-per-column or warp-group-per-column layouts while preserving staged vcol/no-barrier gains, warp reductions, n32, classifier, and mixed paths; keep only if n176 bucket and full geomean improve.

Replace PyTorch boolean-index mixed split routing in fb0081 with CUDA-built compact index lists or lightweight gather/scatter dispatch, preserving rankdef-first, clustered scans, n32/n176 paths, and dense fallback; profile parent first, benchmark mixed n512/n1024 plus geomean, and revert if compaction overhead exceeds boolean indexing.

Combine 91d345's n176 16-column tiled trailing-update win with fb0081's rankdef-first structural classifier bandwidth win: use 91d345 as base, transplant only fb0081's rankdef-first precedence/short-circuit classifier changes, preserve n32, mixed-split, dense fallback, and n176 tiled behavior, then validate and benchmark the pure stack before any further edits.

Combine ca6bd8's best n176 16-column predicate-free/tail-split tiling with fb0081's rankdef-first classifier short-circuit, using ca6bd8 as base and transplanting only classifier precedence/short-circuit changes; preserve n32, mixed split, dense fallback, and n176 full-tile behavior, then validate and benchmark the pure stack before any further edits.

From 87d8, prototype an executable load_inline CUDA reduced-QR path only for all-eligible n512 rankdef batches: specialize to the detected leading width used by the existing reduced torch.geqrf path, preserve compact geqrf output padding/layout plus n176/n32/classifier/mixed/dense fallbacks, benchmark against reduced torch.geqrf, and abandon before n1024/mixed if n512 rankdef is not faster.

Micro-tune only the n176 predicate-free/tail-split tiled update from 87d8: sweep tile width/register layout around the current 16-column local/scale arrays, test 24/32 columns only if ptxas occupancy/spills stay acceptable, and try smaller packed local storage to reduce register pressure; preserve classifier, n32, mixed, dense, and rankdef behavior; keep only if n176 bucket improves without geomean regression.

Specialize homogeneous classifier outcomes on 87d8: when CUDA counts show the entire n512/n1024 batch is rankdef or clustered, bypass boolean-mask construction, compact-index routing, and dense/eligible split; dispatch directly to the existing corresponding reduced-width geqrf/padded-output path. Preserve mixed batches, n176/n32 behavior, dense fallback, rankdef-over-cluster precedence, and do not change reduced QR kernels except thin routing wrappers; validate homogeneous and mixed edge cases, and compare against 87d8 on homogeneous n512/n1024 plus full geomean.

Micro-tune only the existing executable n32 CUDA QR fast path on 87d8d1f: profile the current single-block Householder kernel and reduce launch/body overhead with warp-only reductions, fewer barriers, fixed-32 loop unrolling, and safe tau/output store trimming; do not alter routing, classifier, n176, mixed, dense, or n512 paths; keep only if validation passes and both n32 bucket and full geomean improve.
